column1: # exomind stack manifest v1 — one component per line: name<TAB>dir<TAB>port<TAB>build_cmd<TAB>test_cmd<TAB>version_flag
# port empty = batch tool (no live daemon). Format: exodoc/standard.md section 7.
# 5th column test_cmd: the in-budget smoke used by the QMS component-tests
# check (5s audit budget). `-` = documented exception (the full suite is
# run by `make test-<name>` and exceeds the audit budget).
# The QMS docs-coverage check gates on files, not the 5th column: every
# module dir needs a README, test/test.sh and standard.md (or docs/).
